analysis: Gated cumulative memory achieved host validation macro HR@10 of 0.4900, improving on the preceding ConvRec result of 0.4788 by 0.0112, but remaining 0.0150 below the SASRec baseline of 0.5050. Category HR@10: Movies_and_TV 0.525, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.535, Electronics 0.375, CDs_and_Vinyl 0.525. Electronics remains the weakest category. The result supports retaining simple causal pooling as a hypothesis, but does not establish why performance changed or demonstrate superiority to the baseline. No test metrics were used.
code_summary: One independently trained ConvRec checkpoint per category. The network combines four causal residual convolution blocks with dilations 1, 2, 4, 8 and two-head causal self-attention. A new memory path cumulatively averages padding-masked, undropped item embeddings, applies a learned tanh projection, and blends memory with contextual features through an elementwise sigmoid gate before final normalization. Tied item embeddings and jointly trained item biases produce candidate scores. Sampling, recency-weighted sampled-softmax loss, optimizer, hyperparameters, and strict validation-improvement checkpoint selection remain unchanged. The predictor imports the same architecture and strictly loads one checkpoint per category. Verification checks finite empty/padded histories, zero padded features, causality, sequence preparation parity, and checkpoint reconstruction agreement.
